verdict.rationale: Klaviyo documents a headless public API through which people and agents can read and write Klaviyo data (klaviyo-docs-46), and pull data out to sync to other systems (klaviyo-docs-18). Segmentation is a core product feature (klaviyo-docs-11), so programmatic audience management is plausible but only implied. No cited evidence names list, segment or tag endpoints, or shows reading back membership. Missing for 10: documented create/update endpoints for lists, segments or tags; endpoints to retrieve the profiles in a list or segment; hands-on or independent corroboration.
